get_config_files: get all DensePose configuration YAML files from the base configs directory
get_evolution_config_files: get all evolution variant configuration files from the evolution subdirectory
get_hrnet_config_files: get all HRNet variant configuration files from the HRNet subdirectory
get_model_config: load a DensePose config from a YAML file and auto-fallback to CPU if no GPU
get_model: build a DensePose model from a YAML config file relative to the configs directory
